description: Interaction intents: the vocabulary of the `intents` and `keyboardIntents` arrays of a component `accessibility` block (spec/accessibility.md), reused unchanged as the events a behavior contract transition or conformance vector names (spec/behavior-contract.md). `usedAs` says which accessibility array carries the value today. Values with `category: event` are the proposal 022 event intents a platform maps a gesture to (focus, press, pointer, logical navigation); they exist only in behavior contracts, never in `accessibility`.

values.label: Trigger
values.description: Activates or invokes an action

values.label: Select
values.description: Selects from a set of options

values.label: Navigate
values.description: Moves the user to another context

values.label: Expand
values.description: Reveals additional content

values.label: Collapse
values.description: Conceals content

values.label: Input
values.description: Accepts user-typed text

values.label: Choose
values.description: Picks a value from a range or discrete set

values.label: Dismiss
values.description: Closes or removes an element

values.label: Activate
values.description: Triggers the component's primary action

values.label: Navigate options
values.description: Moves focus through a list of options

values.label: Navigate items
values.description: Moves focus between peer elements (tabs, toolbar items)

values.label: Increment
values.description: Increases a numeric or ranged value

values.label: Decrement
values.description: Decreases a numeric or ranged value

values.label: Select all
values.description: Selects all items in a collection

values.label: Focus
values.description: The part receives focus. `via` (`keyboard`, `pointer`, `programmatic`) decides `focusVisible`.

values.label: Blur
values.description: Focus leaves the part.

values.label: Press start
values.description: A press begins on the part.

values.label: Press end
values.description: A press completes on the part; the part's `press` intent follows.

values.label: Press cancel
values.description: A press ends somewhere other than the part.

values.label: Pointer enter
values.description: A pointer moves over the part. Needs `pointer-hover`.

values.label: Pointer leave
values.description: A pointer moves off the part. Needs `pointer-hover`.

values.label: Navigate next
values.description: Logical movement to the next peer. The platform maps arrows and flips them for right-to-left.

values.label: Navigate previous
values.description: Logical movement to the previous peer.

values.label: Navigate first
values.description: Logical movement to the first peer.

values.label: Navigate last
values.description: Logical movement to the last peer.
